issue.title: CVE-2026-107678
issue.body:
一、漏洞信息
 漏洞编号：[CVE-2026-107678](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-107678)
 漏洞归属组件：[ffmpeg](https://atomgit.com/src-openeuler/ffmpeg)
 漏洞归属的版本：4.2.4,6.1.1,6.1.6,7.1,7.1.5,9.0.2
 CVSS评分：
  BaseScore：0.0 None
  Vector：
 漏洞简述：
  FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a stack exhaustion vulnerability in av_encryption_init_info_free() in libavutil/encryption_info.c, which recursively frees AVEncryptionInitInfo linked lists built by the MOV demuxer s mov_read_pssh(). Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with tens of thousands of small pssh boxes to exhaust the stack and crash the process, while also causing quadratic CPU consumption.
 漏洞公开时间：2026-10-09 00:17:05
 漏洞创建时间：2026-10-17 16:38:43
 漏洞详情参考链接：
  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-107678

 影响性分析说明：
  FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a stack exhaustion vulnerability in av_encryption_init_info_free() in libavutil/encryption_info.c, which recursively frees AVEncryptionInitInfo linked lists built by the MOV demuxer s mov_read_pssh(). Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with tens of thousands of small pssh boxes to exhaust the stack and crash the process, while also causing quadratic CPU consumption.
 openEuler评分：
  4.7
 Vector：CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H
